ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Before incorporation and on an ongoing risk-based basis, screen all directors, shareholders, authorized representatives, beneficial owners, counterparties, and relevant intermediaries against United Nations Security Council sanctions, European Union restrictive measures implemented through EU regulations, Spanish domestic sanctions and law-enforcement information where lawfully available, and OFAC lists where United States nexus, USD clearing, US persons, or contractual requirements create relevant exposure. Apply Law 10/2010 and Royal Decree 304/2014 PEP rules, including enhanced due diligence, senior-management approval, source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification, and enhanced ongoing monitoring for domestic and foreign PEPs, their family members, and known close associates. Resolve false positives using documented identifiers and retain screening evidence.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Mercantil Central (RMC) online name-certification service: https://www.rmc.es; incorporation processing may also use the CIRCE system and the official PAE portal, subject to eligibility and notarial workflow
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company name must be distinct from existing registered names and must include the legal form designation or its permitted abbreviation, such as Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada or S.L. Names may generally use Spanish or other legally acceptable languages, but may not be misleading, contrary to law, public order, or good customs. Non-Latin scripts and transliterations require practical validation by the RMC and notary; a translated or transliterated trading name does not replace the mandatory registered legal name. The RMC certificate must be issued in the exact name used in the incorporation deed.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Tokens identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered company name

Governmental, royal, official, or institutional terms such as Estado, Gobierno, Ministerio, Nacional, Oficial, Real, Corona, Banco, Bolsa, Seguro, Crédito, or Instituto where use may imply official status or regulated activity
Terms suggesting regulated financial, insurance, securities, telecommunications, energy, education, healthcare, or public-authority activity without the necessary authorization
Terms contrary to law, public order, public morals, or capable of causing material confusion regarding the company's purpose, ownership, or public character
Protected trademarks, trade names, or other third-party identifiers where use would create infringement or confusion risk
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Apply electronically or through an authorized intermediary to the Registro Mercantil Central for a negative name certificate. After issuance, use the certificate within its statutory incorporation period; the certificate is generally effective for three months for execution of the incorporation deed, while the name is reserved for six months. If rejected, obtain the written reason, compare the proposed name against the RMC naming rules and existing entries, submit a corrected alternative or request reconsideration with supporting evidence through the RMC administrative channel, and, where an appealable administrative act exists, file the applicable administrative appeal under Law 39/2015 within the stated deadline. A judicial challenge may be considered under the contentious-administrative procedure after exhausting or appropriately addressing the administrative route. A rejection caused by similarity is normally resolved more efficiently by submitting alternative names.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A Spanish S.L. must have a registered office in Spain under the Capital Companies Law. A serviced or virtual office may be acceptable as the registered office if it provides a genuine address, receives official notices, maintains required corporate records or access arrangements, and accurately reflects the company's administrative center where applicable. It is not sufficient for a regulated activity, customs-sensitive operation, manufacturing activity, warehouse operation, employment base, or tax-residency position requiring genuine management and operational substance. Precision hydraulic-valve manufacturing should maintain demonstrable production, engineering, inventory, quality-control, logistics, or outsourced-manufacturing arrangements appropriate to its actual model.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: No official national percentage is published for unannounced inspections of newly incorporated S.L.s. For the stated non-regulated manufacturing and trading profile, the indicative compliance risk is low to medium, approximately 10% to 20% over the first 24 months, increasing materially where the company claims manufacturing capacity without premises, requests VAT or EORI-related registrations, imports goods, applies for public incentives, operates from a high-risk virtual-office address, or presents inconsistent tax, banking, payroll, and logistics data. This percentage is a planning estimate, not a statutory probability.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, de 2 de julio, por el que se aprueba el texto refundido de la Ley de Sociedades de Capital (LSC), particularly Articles 19, 21, 22 (incorporation deed), 28 and 29 (share capital of Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada), 62 (public deed and registration), and 210 (administration organs); complementary Royal Decree 1784/1996 (Reglamento del Registro Mercantil), Articles 175-191.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Central (central name reservation and certification) and the competent Provincial Registro Mercantil (commercial registry) at the company's registered address; registration coordination by the Colegio de Registradores de España.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura pública de constitución (public incorporation deed) granted before a Spanish notary, followed by presentation of the certified deed for entry in the Hoja registral de la sociedad in the Provincial Registro Mercantil.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: For Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada the minimum capital is EUR 3,000 (approx. USD 3,250), fully subscribed and fully paid in at the date of incorporation; capital must be paid via bank deposit into a Spanish escrow account (certificado de depósito) or paid-up in kind, and the notary must confirm payment before executing the deed.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The sole founder or the appointed incorporators, acting by unanimous written resolution, hereby: (1) approve the draft public deed of incorporation of the Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada in accordance with Articles 19-21 LSC; (2) confirm that the share capital of EUR 3,000 has been fully subscribed and paid in and that the statutory escrow certificate has been obtained; (3) adopt the registered office at Calle Príncipe de Vergara, 123, 28002 Madrid; (4) appoint the founder as sole Administrator, accepting office and powers; (5) authorize the notary and the Administrator to sign all ancillary public and private documents, obtain tax identifications, and complete inscription in the Registro Mercantil.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Central, Ministry of Justice online portal (MRCyD electronic service)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online petition for a negative name certificate requesting up to five proposed company names, including 'Precision Hydraulic Valves SL'; the certificate confirms absence of identical or confusingly similar prior registrations and is valid for two months renewable for a further two months.
required_dossiers: Form of solicitud de certificación de denominación social
Certificate of non-offensive name (declaration)
Identification of applicant and proposed company name(s)
Payment of the official name certification fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried due to similarity or missing documentation, the deficient items must be remedied within the remaining validity window by filing a corrected request or by appealing the registry decision through the Registro Mercantil Central's appeal procedure within two months.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Escrow Deposit of Share Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish credit institution or bank branch (account opened in the name of the company in formation)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a provisional corporate account in the name of 'Precision Hydraulic Valves SL (Sociedad en Formación)' at a Spanish bank and deposit the minimum paid-up capital of EUR 3,000. Obtain a bank certificate of deposit (certificado de ingreso) expressly stating the depositor, the corporate name in formation, the amount deposited, and the date and purpose of deposit.
required_dossiers: Draft incorporation deed or authorization letter from the incorporators
Negative name certificate (first step result)
NIE or passport of the incorporation signatory
Bank account opening forms and AML declarations
Certificate of receipt of capital (certificado de depósito de fondos)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the account opening due to incomplete beneficial ownership data, provide the required identity and source-of-funds declarations and restart the deposit; if the escrow certificate has defects, obtain a corrected statement before proceeding to notarization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Approval of the Articles of Association (Estatutos)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporators; reviewed by a Spanish corporate counsel and the notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the estatutos containing corporate name, object clause (manufacture of high-pressure fluid power cylinders and proportional valves under ISIC 2812 / NAICS 332912), registered office, share capital, shares and voting rights, administration system, financial year, and winding-up rules; ensure the object clause is sufficiently broad to cover ancillary imports, distribution and repairs.
required_dossiers: Draft estatutos (articles of association)
Corporate registry regulations and Spanish law checklist (LSC requirements)
Resolution of the incorporators approving the final text
Tax and sector licensing consultation of the object clause
Power of attorney if any incorporator is represented
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary queries statutory inconsistencies, amend the estatutos by supplementary written resolution and re-submit the corrected draft for notarial pre-review before scheduling the deed execution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Public Incorporation Deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish Notary (Notario) elected by the incorporators
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Appear before the notary, present the negative name certificate, bank deposit certificate, and approved estatutos, and execute the escritura pública de constitución. The notary will verify legal capacity, payment of capital, and the object clause, and will also advise on the use of the online incorporation platform (CIRCE) if applicable.
required_dossiers: Certificación negativa de denominación social (name certificate)
Certificado de depósito bancario or valuation report for non-cash contributions
Approved articles of association
Identity documents and NIE numbers of all founding partners
Statutory declaration of absence of disqualification to hold office
Payment of notarial fees (arancel notarial)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary raises objections, correct the identified legal deficiencies, amend the deed schedule, or request a formal notarial declaration of defect; execute a corrective deed if the defect is material.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtaining the Temporary Tax Identification Number (CIF Provisional / NIF Definitivo)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish Tax Administration Agency (Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria, AEAT)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within one month of notarization, file form 036 with AEAT to request the provisional NIF for the company in formation, and then request the definitive NIF within the legally established term after presentation of the copy of the deed at AEAT. Submit the incorporation deed to the relevant local AEAT office and obtain the definitive tax identification certificate.
required_dossiers: Official dossier of the public incorporation deed (primera copia)
Form 036 (declaración censal)
Bank certificate of capital deposit
Name certificate and duly certified articles of association
Identity documents of the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If AEAT queries the application, correct the census registration by filing an amended Form 036 or provide the notarially certified deed; administrative delays may be cured by presenting a supplementary copy at the same AEAT office and requesting expedited resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscription in the Provincial Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil de Madrid (or the competent Provincial Registry of the registered office)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After obtaining the definitive NIF, present the first certified copy of the public incorporation deed and the required forms to the commercial registry corresponding to the registered office. The registrador will review legality, capital, and governance provisions, and will issue the inscription certificate (certificación de la inscripción) which concludes the company's effective incorporation.
required_dossiers: Primera copia of the notarial incorporation deed
AEAT Form 036 filing receipt or definitive NIF certificate
Payment of registry fees (arancel registral)
Validation of the negative name certificate validity
Documents evidencing appointment of the Administrator and acceptance of office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrador suspends or proposes qualification defects, the founding partners must correct the deed by means of a rectification instrument or by appealing the qualification to the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública within the legal deadlines; correct any deficiency and re-present the deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication in the Official Gazette and Post-Registration Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Boletín Oficial del Registro Mercantil (BORME); AEAT; Social Security Administration (Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registry transmits the incorporation entry to the BORME for publication. Following inscription, file the definitive census declaration with AEAT, formalize accounting ledgers, register the Administrator (
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the BORME publication is delayed, obtain the registry certificate as evidence of incorporation. For any associated labor registration queries, remedy by filing corrections and affording the Administration the original incorporation deed and registration certificate.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Consejería de Industria of the Autonomous Community in which the plant is located (e.g. Comunidad de Madrid) and the municipal authority responsible for licensing economic activity; secondary industrial supervision by the Ministry of Industry, Trade and Tourism.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia de actividad y funcionamiento (municipal economic activity license) and, where applicable, the Autorización Ambiental Integrada for installations subject to the Ley 4/2013 de residuos or the Ley 21/2013 de evaluación ambiental.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Dirección General de Medio Ambiente of the relevant Autonomous Community, with national coordination by the Dirección General de Calidad y Evaluación Ambiental del Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico (MITECO)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C / Non-significant EIA registration (screening exemption) for light precision valve assembly and test operations under ISIC 2812, unless the hydraulic testing loop uses more than the threshold quantities of oils or degreasers, in which case a Simplified Environmental Assessment (Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental Simplificada) is required under Annex II of Ley 21/2013.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with water discharge limits under Real Decreto 1620/2007 and regional sewer standards for neutralized wash water; adherence to VOC emission limits of Directive 2010/75/EU (industrial emissions) and Real Decreto 117/2003 for the use of organic solvents; all hazardous wastes must be recorded and managed through registered carriers under Ley 7/2022, with maximum wastewater pH 6-9, hydrocarbons below 15 ppm, and heavy metals below regulatory thresholds.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate and plan approved by the local fire service (Servicio de Prevención de Incendios) under Real Decreto 2267/2004 for industrial establishments; structural load inspection certificate for any hydraulic test benches and pressurization rooms; and workplace occupational risk prevention plan under Ley 31/1995, including high-pressure equipment inspection, first aid, and worker training records endorsed by the autonomous labor authority.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), official portal https://www.agenciatributaria.gob.es/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities obtain NIF (CIF/NIE) by registering with AEAT via Spanish tax representative or direct submission of incorporation documents, address proof, and application forms through the AEAT portal or authorized offices; mandatory for economic activity in Spain.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box elections; unitary national system with limited hybrid mismatch rules under EU directives; SME regimes (Régimen Simplificado de Estimación Objetiva) available but inapplicable to standard SL entities.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: 30,000 EUR annual turnover threshold triggering mandatory VAT registration
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory Facturae electronic invoicing and digital stamping for B2B transactions; real-time fiscal clearance via AEAT platform with API integration and mandatory reporting for all taxable supplies.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% IVA rate for goods exported outside the EU and certain offshore services; requires proof of actual export and non-re-entry into Spain.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Despacho de Exportación), Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent zero-rating claims subject to penalties up to 100% of evaded tax, interest, retrospective refund clawback, and criminal prosecution under Spanish tax code.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España (Bank of Spain), acting simultaneously as Spain's national central bank, as part of the Eurosystem, and under the EU Single Supervisory Mechanism; the foreign exchange administration function is shared with the Ministry of Economy and Digital Transformation under Law 19/2003 on Capital Movements and Royal Decree 1816/1991.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain is a euro-area member with full current-account and capital-account convertibility in the European Economic Area. Non-resident shareholders may inject equity, subscribe to debt, repatriate dividends, and liquidate capital without exchange-control approval. Practical barriers arise only from banking AML/KYC obligations under Law 10/2010 and from tax-driven reporting duties. Profit remittance is generally subject to Spanish dividend withholding tax (19% domestic standard, reduced to 5–10% under many double-tax treaties), but there is no FX conversion block, no investment-type restriction and no licensing veto for a standard manufacturing company.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: The mandatory surrender ratio is 0% — Spanish law does not require exporters to convert foreign-currency export proceeds into euros, nor to deposit them within any hard statutory period in a designated central-bank account. Export collections may be kept in EUR or foreign currency accounts at authorised credit institutions. However, any cross-border receipt in excess of EUR 12,500 is subject to balance-of-payments statistical declaration through the banking channel to Banco de España; exporters must also preserve the customs export declaration (SAD/DUA), contracts, and payment evidence for at least five years to comply with VAT and AML record-keeping requirements.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (blocked transferable account) and EUR Operational Current Account
Capital Escrow Account and Multi-Currency Operational Current Account
Capital Escrow Account and International Business Current Account
Operational Current Account with FX Derivative Line
Operational Current Account and Cash Pooling Structure

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium only for ancillary collections through EEA cross-border passporting; Low as a primary treasury or clearing bank. Spanish-authorised electronic-money institutions and payment institutions can provide SEPA transfers, IBAN accounts, and simple FX conversion, but they cannot issue or advise documentary letters of credit, provide committed trade finance, settle via TARGET2, or act as correspondent for commercial LC clearing. A non-EEA digital EMI is materially incompatible with Spanish manufacturing trade flows and should be confined to low-value pilot payments, never as the main liquidity rail.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Tier-1 Spanish banks require at least one signatory with treasury authority to attend a physical branch appointment during initial account opening. Pure remote onboarding is available only for signatories already holding a Spanish electronic DNI/NIE and a qualified eIDAS certificate; non-resident directors must generally either appear in person in Spain or execute a notarised power-of-attorney with Hague Apostille, original passport copies, and certified Spanish translation before the opening is approved.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-EEA ultimate beneficial owner with an opaque Latin American holding chain and no Spanish NIE identification
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized corporate structure diagram; UBO register excerpts from the relevant commercial registry; certified passport copies of each UBO with Apostille and sworn Spanish translation; NIE certificate or official Spanish fiscal representative appointment; source-of-funds statement supported by twelve months of bank statements; board resolution delegating treasury powers; company deed; current bylaws and tax identification card.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Enhanced-due-diligence exposure to customers in high-risk or formerly FATF-monitored jurisdictions for hydraulic valve resale
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full commercial contract and final invoice; Spanish customs SAD/DUE export declaration; bills of lading or airway bills; certificate of origin; end-user certificate for the precision hydraulic valves; prior transaction track record; down-stream KYC summary; sanctions and PEP screening report from an independent external provider.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid high-value MT103 receipt into the target entity before notary capitalisation documents are registered
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Share subscription agreement certified by a Spanish notary; pre-injection bank reference from the remitting institution; statutory share register update; capital injection resolution from the board; reconciliation certificate from a registered auditor or tax adviser; foreign investment statistical declaration filed with Banco de España.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route all shareholder capital injections through SWIFT MT103 to the Spanish SL's IBAN, quoting the ISO 20022 category purpose 'CAPH' with the remittance narrative 'Capital subscription - ES_SL'. The receiving Spanish bank applies sanctions and AML screening before releasing funds into a temporarily blocked capital escrow account; the notary deed and applicable stamp-duty inquiry must be completed before the escrow is converted into a free current account. If funds arrive from Latin American jurisdictions with exchange controls, obtain an advance convertibility confirmation from the originating bank and retain all corresponding permits. Any receipt exceeding EUR 12,500 must be included in the monthly balance-of-payments statistical declaration to Banco de España.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use TARGET2/IBAN instant transfer for urgent domestic and EU supplier payments; SEPA Credit Transfer for routine low-value European invoices; SWIFT MT103 for cross-border open-account trade settlements; SWIFT MT700/MT707 plus MT202 COV for documentary import and export letters of credit. For high-value purchases from unknown or unrated suppliers, require an irrevocable confirmed commercial LC with presentation of transport, insurance, and certificate-of-origin documents, settled through a Spanish correspondent bank. All foreign disbursements above EUR 12,500 must be reported in the monthly balance-of-payments declaration to the Bank of Spain.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable EUR/USD outright FX forwards with maturities matched to commercial invoice due dates
EUR/MXN and EUR/BRL deliverable FX forwards and FX swaps for Latin American trade flows
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for currencies without a regularly accessible spot delivery market in Spain, strictly limited to hedges of real trade receivables
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps for bilateral external financing above EUR 5 million, executed under EMIR clearing and margining rules
European-style currency options and zero-cost collar structures, purchased as hedge-only instruments with full MiFID suitability documentation
FX swaps (swap de divisas) for rolling treasury liquidity without creating an open speculative position

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after approval by the General Meeting of Shareholders
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines of 300-6,000 euros; non-filing within three months after approval may result in court-ordered administrative dissolution

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 20 April following the end of the calendar tax year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalties of 5% per month of the tax due, plus surcharges and interest

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit required if the company exceeds two of the following: total assets exceeding 2 million euros, net turnover exceeding 10 million euros, or average number of employees exceeding 50
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish General Accounting Plan (Plan General de Contabilidad)

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No annual UBO confirmation required; beneficial ownership information must be updated in the Registro Mercantil only upon changes in shareholding or control

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 100-500 USD for virtual registered office or corporate agent services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 2,000-5,000 USD if independent audit is mandated

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (Impuesto sobre Sociedades; art. 29.1 Ley 27/2014, as amended; general rate for all resident S.L. entities and Spanish permanent establishments of non-residents)
